properties.citation: Salem Chaker, « Amaziɣ (le/un Berbère) », Encyclopédie berbère, IV, 1986, p. 562-568, § 6: Amāheγ/Imūhaγ in the Ahaggar and the Ajjer, Amājeγ/Imājeγen in the Aïr and the south (Niger-Mali), Amāšeγ/Imūšaγ in the Adrar des Ifoghas. Anchor: Natural Earth populated place Tessalit, MLI (Adrar des Ifoghas; the Adrar is not a Natural Earth region and Kidal is not a Natural Earth place).
properties.derivation: Built by social/video/areas.mjs: a circle of 1° radius around the Natural Earth town Tessalit (the anchor rule of the Tuareg area), on Africa's land (Africa's land is the union of the Natural Earth Admin 0 countries whose CONTINENT is Africa); on a 0.05° grid (cells whose centre falls inside), traced back as the cell boundary, simplified by Douglas–Peucker at 0.05° and rounded to 0.01°; parts and holes under 5000 km² dropped. It stands for the Adrar des Ifoghas, centred on its northern town rather than on Kidal; the massif reaches further south.
